name: w5a16_q5_0_fp32_n4096_k4096
description: General matrix multiply (GEMM) C = A @ B.T. Captured from Llama family - higher precision weight quantization (Q5_0, hidden_size=4096). Used when Q4_0 quality is insufficient.

weight.description: Q5_0 quantized weight tensor. Each block is 22 bytes

reference:
import torch
import struct

def dequantize_q5_0_block(block_bytes):
    """Dequantize block_q5_0 (22 bytes) to 32 float values"""
    d = struct.unpack('<e', block_bytes[:2])[0]
    qh = block_bytes[2:6]   # uint8[4] - high bits
    qs = block_bytes[6:22]  # uint8[16] - low 4 bits
    values = []
    for i in range(32):
        ql = (qs[i//2] >> (4 * (i % 2))) & 0x0F
        qh = (qh[i//8] >> (i % 8)) & 1
        q = (qh << 4) | ql
        values.append((q - 16) * d)
    return torch.tensor(values, dtype=torch.float32)

@torch.no_grad()
def run(activation, weight):
    """
    Reference implementation for W5A16 GEMM.
    activation: [M, K] float32
    weight: [N, K/32] as block_q5_0
    returns: [M, N] float32
    """
    M, K = activation.shape
    N = weight.shape[0]
    num_blocks = K // 32
    
    weight_dequant = torch.zeros(N, K, dtype=torch.float32)
    for n in range(N):
        for b in range(num_blocks):
            block_values = dequantize_q5_0_block(weight[n, b])
            weight_dequant[n, b*32:(b+1)*32] = block_values
    
    output = torch.matmul(activation, weight_dequant.T)
    return output
